# Catálogo de arquetipos

El primer estilo, stack y persistencia de cada lista es el valor por defecto.

| Arquetipo | Rol | Estilos | Stack | Persistencia | Despliegue | API REST |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `experience` | Channel API (web, mobile, partners); adapts and aggregates, owns no domain | bff | servlet, reactive | – | deployment | sí |
| `business` | Owner of a domain and its data; business rules | hexagonal, cqrs, layered | servlet, reactive | aurora, dynamodb | deployment | sí |
| `process` | Orchestrates long-running processes across domains (sagas) | hexagonal, cqrs | servlet | aurora | deployment | sí |
| `integration` | Anti-corruption layer in front of systems of record, legacy and third parties | hexagonal, cqrs | servlet, reactive | none, dynamodb | deployment | sí |
| `event-processor` | Consumes and reacts to events, without a public API | eda | servlet, reactive | none, aurora, dynamodb | deployment | no |
| `batch` | File processing and reconciliations, run as a Kubernetes CronJob | batch | servlet | aurora | cronjob | no |
| `crud` | Simple maintenance tables and catalogs | layered | servlet | aurora, dynamodb | deployment | sí |
| `library` | Plain Java library for the ecosystem (layer 1 rules apply) | none | servlet | – | none | no |
| `starter` | New axiz capability (layer 1 library + layer 2 Spring Boot starter) | none | servlet | – | none | no |
